name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Murasu, on a GDACS red alert, due to hit south Andhra Pradesh late on 2 Nov
state: GDACS kept a red alert for Cyclone Murasu in the Bay of Bengal on 1 Nov. India's Meteorological Department expects it to cross the south Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Narsapur between 23:30 on 2 Nov and 04:00 on 3 Nov local time, with winds of 100–110km/h gusting to 120km/h. Odisha ordered evacuations of low-lying areas on 1 Nov.
for_you: People in or travelling to coastal Andhra Pradesh, north Tamil Nadu and southern Odisha should follow India Meteorological Department warnings and local authority instructions. Check FCDO travel advice for India before travelling.

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
